Obtainable after you unlock the [[dungeon]] as part of the [[Astrologer]]'s quest.  Once you give the [[active key]] to [[Snake]] you'll get a cutscene in which the player dies to a fire trap while trying to retrieve this item.  Afterward [[Snake]] allows you to enter the dungeon, giving you a quest of his own, and the trap is disabled allowing you to retrieve the diary.
